answer: Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the marble beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. Rotation is written down in the dawn index and the terrace audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 42 keys live and online for the whole period, and therefore the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
